summary: Compile native source trigger references into the existing deferred IVM journal

replay.detail: No replay, automatic install or migration; explicit library setup only.

schema.detail: Reuses existing opt-in Installer deferred metadata and journal. The API itself installs no schema or triggers.

rules.detail: No admission, authority, canonical ordering or checkpoint changes.

compatibility.detail: New literal-only capture plan API for full-PK native tables. Existing capture and publication APIs remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: Default Store path is unchanged; no native production activation.

manual.detail: A source owner explicitly installs complete AFTER mutation triggers and retains immutable old/new cells at each Installer revision.

recovery.detail: Logical capture gaps preserve valid raw writes while fencing source roots/jobs. Storage errors require source rollback. Explicit complete fresh publication is required to recover.
